method: Image-to-image editorial redesign of the original generated SVG layout
promptSummary: Redesign the nine-stage Observatory pipeline in the Evidence Press dark-teal, blue, amber and cream visual system; preserve the stages and flow; keep every heading, description and terminal-status label fully inside its box; use clear high-contrast editorial typography.
review: Inspected at original resolution for legibility, complete labels and absence of text overflow before inclusion.
evidentiaryRole: Explanatory artwork only; it is not research evidence or a verification artefact.
